title: Covered question reply isolation
summary: Verify that normal Hero Meeting, Town, battle and movement questions resolve once and restore current controls after the server confines covered replies to the answering player's query stack. The wrong-player packet rejection is covered by real-server automated tests.
preparation: Install the exact checksum-verified candidate APK with the companion. Use a disposable save with two meeting heroes, a Town visitor, a hero able to move into an event or encounter, and a battle that can lead to level-up. Use multiplayer if available for ordinary separate-player dialogs; it is not required to forge network packets.
limitations: Mark unavailable game scenarios Blocked with notes. Device play cannot directly prove a forged wrong-player reply; the real-server regression test covers it. CI does not establish physical acceptance, and this candidate does not complete the activity-system migration or authorize merging.

checks.title: Hero Meeting and exchange answers
checks.steps: Open a two-hero Meeting; transfer and split units in both directions, close the exchange, and reopen it. If multiplayer is available, have the other player open and dismiss their own dialog while the first player has a pending exchange.
checks.expected: Each legal transfer applies once to the intended armies. Closing or dismissing a question releases only its own player; no stuck exchange, cross-player resolution, stale army or duplicate acknowledgement remains.

checks.title: Town visitor and confirmation dialogs
checks.steps: Open a Town with a visitor; transfer garrison/visitor units, confirm or cancel one available recruitment or build question, and reopen the Town after dismissal.
checks.expected: The chosen answer applies once to the correct town or army. Cancellation leaves resources unchanged, dialogs close normally, and current upper and lower Town context returns.

checks.title: Battle result and level-up continuation
checks.steps: Finish a battle against neutral units, dismiss the result, and answer any level-up choice. Return to Adventure and repeat a routine battle action with the controller.
checks.expected: The battle result and any reward/level-up resolve once in the expected order. No question remains stuck; Adventure restores and battle controls do not leak into it.

checks.title: Movement interruption and recovery
checks.steps: Move a hero into an encounter or event that raises a question; answer or cancel it, then issue another move or Stop/Continue action. Try a rapid repeat while a question is visible.
checks.expected: Movement pauses for the active question and resumes or stops according to the answer. Only the current action executes; stale repeats cause no duplicate move or pending control.

checks.title: Dual-screen and input recovery
checks.steps: During Meeting, Town and result/dialog states, toggle/reconnect the lower display and background/resume. Dismiss the question with normal upper touch/controller input, then check lower controls and lower-disabled play.
checks.expected: One current lower presentation restores without stale hit regions or held gestures. Upper touch/controller remain usable and each player returns to the correct current context.
